newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's National Jet appoints new GM.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's National Jet appoints new GM.

text.p: Australia's largest independent air carrier, National Jet Systems (NJS) Group, said on Monday it had appointed former Qantas Airways Ltd's executive Mike Grehan to a new position of general manager.
NJS executive chairman Warren Seymour said in a statement the appointment followed a restructuring of the privately owned company's management team after a review by external consultants.
Grehan was formerly Qantas's financial controller for its associated business division, where he oversaw development of its regional airlines, flight catering and air freight, he said.
